title: W118 Work-specific Task Register — Sandbox/GitHub Dual Closed Loops
model: W118 Work-level planning Task Register modeled on W70 DOC-093. It is not a runtime Core Task/Assignment/Event database; Core :8000 is the sole runtime Task/Assignment/Event authority.
rules: One canonical Work-level planning Task Register for W118; Sandbox is its operational project-planning authority.
This register tracks W118 implementation tasks and Work Package progress; it is not the runtime Core Task/Assignment/Event store.

Core :8000 is the sole canonical runtime Task/Assignment/Event authority; W102 owns Agent Loop policy; W14 is the sole product/delivery owner for integrated execution, GitHub Gateway and CI; W12/W13 are absorbed internal foundations.
GitHub Issue mirror is generated from a normalized Core Task snapshot, not directly from this planning register.
execution_mode is a Work-level implementation authorization classification, not a runtime Agent Assignment state.
Owner-directed build tasks require owner_directive_ref; no Agent principal/ACK is fabricated.
Do not create a local Task database, dispatcher, durable event queue, event bus, execution host or CI engine in W118.

tasks.objective: Normalize an approved Core :8000 Task snapshot into a read-only GitHub-facing projection; do not create local runtime Task state.
tasks.deliverable: Core Task projection DTO and explicit field-map adapter

acceptance_criteria.description: Task status uses PLANNED/READY/IN_PROGRESS/BLOCKED/IN_REVIEW/DONE/CANCELLED.
Assignment status is a separate state machine and cannot be conflated with Task status.
DONE requires Assignment ACCEPTED and Owner evidence.

blockers: Core :8000 API schema/port and approved field map have not been exposed to W118.
tasks.next_action: Complete stateless Core Task projection only after Core owner exposes the actual API schema, field map and approved read port.
tasks.status_note: Separate Task/Assignment lifecycle code passes contract CI; runtime service integration remains pending.
tasks.scope_boundary: W118 Work-specific Task Register only; do not create a cross-Work task engine or mutate W70 schema.
tasks.verification_method: JSON schema validation, unit/contract tests, exact-SHA CI and Sandbox readback.
tasks.completion_rule: Canonical Sandbox Task Register and runtime adapter round-trip with no duplicate authority; all contract tests PASS.

tasks.task_title: W102/Core Agent identity and Assignment integration
tasks.objective: Connect GitHub handoff/ACK observations to existing Core/W102 identity and Assignment policy without creating a W118 Agent Registry or dispatcher.
tasks.role_name: Xu / AI-01 coordinates; Vinh owns identity authority
tasks.deliverable: Approved integration mapping for Core principal, W102 policy decision and Assignment/ACK events

acceptance_criteria.description: Every selectable Agent maps to a verified runtime principal.
Capability/availability/permission match is recorded with policy version.
Unknown or unverified identity fails closed.

blockers: Core identity/Assignment API and verified runtime principal are not exposed to W118.
tasks.next_action: Obtain the Core/W102 identity and Assignment contract plus a verified principal fixture; do not infer identity or build a local Agent Registry.
tasks.status_note: Governance role labels do not prove runtime identity. No Agent can be marked eligible by inference.
tasks.scope_boundary: Do not create GitHub login, token, or identity mapping by assumption; no permission escalation.
tasks.verification_method: Positive and negative identity/capability authorization tests.
tasks.completion_rule: At least one real executor principal is independently verified and safely selectable.

tasks.task_title: Core Task to GitHub Issue and source binding
tasks.objective: Mirror a normalized Core Task snapshot to a GitHub Issue and validate Task-scoped branch/commit/push binding.
inputs: GitHub Issues and push payload contract
tasks.deliverable: Core Task Issue projection adapter and source binding validator

acceptance_criteria.description: Issue mirror create/update/readback is idempotent and never assigns AI by GitHub Assignee.
Task branch and every commit carry the same Work/Task/Issue IDs.
Force push, missing SHA, malformed binding and legacy branch inference are rejected.

blockers: Core API field map/lock lease and live GitHub token are not exposed; task-scoped push has not run.
tasks.next_action: Finish stateless Issue mirror/source-binding contracts; execute live Issue API and task-scoped push only when authorized credentials and Core source snapshot are available.
tasks.status_note: Contract code and tests exist; live GitHub API and task-specific branch runtime proof pending.
tasks.scope_boundary: GitHub Issue is a mirror; no merge, branch protection bypass, assignee mutation or Issue close without Owner acceptance.
tasks.verification_method: GitHub API readback, exact SHA push validation, idempotency and negative tests.
tasks.completion_rule: One real Task has one linked GitHub Issue and a task-scoped branch/commit/push verified at exact SHA.

tasks.task_title: Stateless webhook verification and Core event intent adapter
tasks.objective: Verify authenticated GitHub events and normalize them into Core event intents; Core owns persistence, deduplication, sequencing and reconciliation.
tasks.deliverable: Stateless HMAC verifier and GitHub event-to-Core event intent adapter

acceptance_criteria.description: Webhook signature, repository, event allowlist and delivery UUID are verified.
Duplicate and replayed deliveries are idempotent; out-of-order CI is deferred.
CI PASS/FAIL records evidence only and never auto-accepts Task.

blockers: Core event ingress is not exposed; production webhook endpoint/secret/TLS is not configured.
tasks.next_action: Complete stateless webhook verification/event normalization; forward to Core event port when exposed; do not persist a local inbox or queue.
tasks.status_note: Authenticated inbox/reconciler contracts pass in-memory tests; production event path is not deployed.
tasks.scope_boundary: Reuse existing Event Listener and W52/W14 event/runtime owners; no new event bus or port.
tasks.verification_method: Signed webhook runtime test, replay/out-of-order tests, exact SHA reconciliation.
tasks.completion_rule: Real GitHub push and workflow_run callbacks reconcile to the correct Sandbox Task with no duplicate or false acceptance.
